definitions.DecodesSatisfying: (packed : Packed Key Payload) → (predicate : List (Key × Payload) → Prop) → Prop := ∃ decoded, unpack packed = some decoded ∧ predicate decoded
definitions.Certificate: structure with entries : List (Key × Payload), predicate : List (Key × Payload) → Prop, evidence : predicate entries
definitions.Certificate.packed: [DecidableEq Payload] → Packed Key Payload := pack certificate.entries

theorems.Certificate.unpack_packed: unpack certificate.packed = some certificate.entries, using existing unpack_pack
theorems.Certificate.predicate_of_successful_equa: unpack revised = some decoded → unpack revised = unpack certificate.packed → certificate.predicate decoded
theorems.Certificate.reuse_of_same_decoding: unpack revised = unpack certificate.packed → DecodesSatisfying revised certificate.predicate
theorems.Certificate.reuse_of_agreement: AgreesOnReferences certificate.packed.dictionary after certificate.packed.references → DecodesSatisfying (replaceDictionary certificate.packed after) certificate.predicate
theorems.Certificate.predicate_after_agreement: AgreesOnReferences ... → unpack (replaceDictionary certificate.packed after) = some decoded → certificate.predicate decoded
theorems.stale_premise_counterexample: Exists original/revised Packed Nat Nat with identical references, equal reference/dictionary lengths, both Valid; original actual decoder satisfies every payload ≤ 7, revised actual decoder does not (7 changes to 8).
